skills.name: changelog

skills.name: codebase-design

skills.name: to-questionnaire
skills.description: Turn a decision you can't fully answer into a questionnaire for someone else to fill in.

skills.name: to-spec

skills.name: triage

skills.name: wizard

catalog.description: Teach the user a new skill or concept, within this workspace.
catalog.label: project:teach

catalog.name: tkt-core
catalog.description: Track tasks as markdown files in your git repo. Use when managing tickets, checking the frontier (what's ready), claiming work, closing tasks, creating tickets, decomposing work into a task graph, or validating project health. Trigger: tkt, tickets, what to work on, create ticket, validate tickets, decompose, break into tasks, work breakdown, task graph, ticket format, blocked by, backlog, park this, defer.
catalog.label: project:tkt-core

catalog.name: tkt-orient
catalog.description: Start-of-session pickup from the reconciled plan and tickets: read the frontier, in-progress threads, and plan ordering that tkt-reconcile left behind, flag stale WIP, and propose the next step. Use when starting a session, resuming after a break, or asking 'where were we?' / 'what's next?' / 'pick up where we left off'. Trigger: start of session, orient, resume, pick up where we left off, where were we, what's next, catch me up, continue, session start, what's on the board.
catalog.label: project:tkt-orient

catalog.name: tkt-reconcile
catalog.description: End-of-session ticket + plan pass: make every ticket current, capture all open work as tickets, and re-prioritize/re-sequence the plan to match current priorities and work streams. Use when wrapping up a session, auditing ticket health, after planning, when work feels untracked, or asking 'is everything captured?' / 'update the plan'. Trigger: sync tickets, update the plan, re-prioritize, end of session ticket pass, ticket review, are tickets current, is everything tracked, ticket audit, ticket hygiene, wrap up tickets, tag scope, work stream.
catalog.label: project:tkt-reconcile

catalog.name: tkt-work
catalog.description: Claim and execute a ticket from the frontier: pick the next ready ticket, claim it, verify its premises against primary sources, do the work, verify acceptance criteria, and close with evidence. The execution loop between tkt-orient (propose) and tkt-reconcile (wrap up). Use when working a ticket, picking up the next task, or asked 'work the frontier' / 'do the next ticket' / 'start on NN'. Trigger: work the frontier, do the next ticket, pick up work, claim and work, start ticket, next on the frontier, work a ticket, execute ticket, close ticket with evidence.
catalog.label: project:tkt-work

catalog.name: to-questionnaire
catalog.description: Turn a decision you can't fully answer into a questionnaire for someone else to fill in.
catalog.label: project:to-questionnaire

catalog.name: to-spec
catalog.description: Turn the current conversation into a spec and publish it to the issue tracker: no interview, just synthesis of what you've already discussed.
catalog.label: project:to-spec

catalog.name: to-tickets
catalog.description: Break a plan, spec, or the current conversation into a set of tracer-bullet tickets, each declaring its blocking edges, created on the tkt tracker.
catalog.label: project:to-tickets

catalog.name: triage
catalog.description: Move external requests (issues, PRs) and internal tkt tickets through triage roles: categorise, verify with real evidence, grill if needed, and write agent-ready briefs. Use when the user asks to triage issues or tickets, or when adopt-project seeds a board from raw items.
catalog.label: project:triage

catalog.name: verify-tkt-usage
catalog.description: Validate every tkt command this repo's skills reference against the live tkt capabilities manifest, catching drift when tkt renames, removes, or re-types a command or flag. Use after a tkt upgrade, or when auditing whether the skills still match the installed tkt.
catalog.label: project:verify-tkt-usage

catalog.name: wait-what
catalog.description: Stop. That last message did not land: re-pitch it.
catalog.label: project:wait-what

catalog.name: wayfinder
catalog.description: Plan a huge chunk of work (more than one agent session can hold) as a shared map of decision tickets on the issue tracker, and resolve them one at a time until the way to the destination is clear.
catalog.label: project:wayfinder

catalog.name: wizard
catalog.description: Generate an interactive bash wizard that walks a human through steps only they can perform. Use when provisioning infrastructure, setting up credentials or CI secrets, walking an unfamiliar third-party dashboard, or running a one-off migration or cutover. Don't invoke this for steps the agent can perform itself.
catalog.label: project:wizard

catalog.name: wrap-session
catalog.description: End-of-session closing bookend: groom the board, groom the environment, and land the cheap mechanical findings now. Runs reconcile-tickets then retro, then writes the guardrail/check/note or project-level skill that a recurring issue calls for instead of only filing it. Use when wrapping up a session, closing out, or asking 'let's wrap this up'.
catalog.label: project:wrap-session

catalog.name: writing-for-agents
catalog.description: Writing documents for agents. Use when creating or editing skills, or modifying AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md.
catalog.label: project:writing-for-agents
